summary: Transform supplied catalog directions and constellation line identities into an observer horizon frame at declared site and times, retaining catalog epoch and unavailable proper-motion fields.
objective: Transform supplied catalog directions and constellation line identities into an observer horizon frame at declared site and times, retaining catalog epoch and unavailable proper-motion fields.
example_prompts: Build observer-frame constellation and horizon playback with explicit units, frames, time and unavailable-data states.

entities.name: Catalog sphere
entities.guidance: Accept supplied star IDs, ICRS directions, reference epoch and optional proper motion/parallax/radial velocity; absent terms stay absent.

entities.name: Observer horizon
entities.guidance: Declare longitude, geodetic latitude, height, UTC, DUT1, polar motion and atmosphere/refraction policy.

entities.name: Constellation links
entities.guidance: Lines connect stable catalog IDs as cultural display metadata; they do not create physical star relationships.

state_contract.model: Pin the IAU SOFA 2023-10-11 C interface and call iauAtco13 for each supplied J2000.0 ICRS catalog row. Require finite rc/dc radians; pr is dRA/dt (not dRA/dt*cos(dec)) and pd is dDec/dt, both radians per Julian year, with parallax arcseconds and radial velocity km/s. Each motion field must be supplied or explicitly declared zero; a non-J2000 catalog requires a separately validated preliminary epoch transformation. Encode UTC using iauDtf2d; supply matching DUT1=UT1-UTC seconds, east-positive WGS84 longitude/geodetic latitude radians, ellipsoid height metres, polar motion xp/yp radians, pressure hPa, temperature Celsius, relative humidity and wavelength micrometres. An explicit pressure=0 policy disables the refraction contribution. Reject status -1 unacceptable date; retain status +1 as a visible dubious-year warning rather than silently accepting it. Require finite observed azimuth/zenith-distance radians.
state_contract.authority: Supplied catalog fields and epoch, pinned SOFA routine/version, UTC encoding, matched Earth-orientation/site/atmosphere inputs and returned numeric directions own state. Blender/glTF contains only the horizon/cardinal context; Three.js binds computed radians to star/link buffers and restores the exact input ledger.
actions: Reset exact catalog and observer state.

invariants: Catalog epoch and time scale are always visible.
Below-horizon status derives from numeric observed direction, not mesh occlusion.
Missing catalog motion terms are never replaced by zero unless input explicitly declares zero.
Constellation line identity survives sorting and magnitude filtering.
motion_guidance: Playback follows stored model/data time; reverse scrub is history and display interpolation never changes the numeric model.
creative_affordances: Use scale-separated context, glyphs and trails while disclosing exaggeration and keeping uncertainty visible.
known_limits: No forecast, dataset execution, numerical solve, render or runtime validation was performed.

claims.statement: IAU SOFA Astrometry Tools documents iauAtco13 from J2000.0 ICRS right ascension/declination, RA and Dec proper motions, parallax and radial velocity through two-part UTC, DUT1, WGS84 terrestrial site, polar motion and atmosphere inputs to observed azimuth and zenith distance, with the listed units; RA proper motion is dRA/dt rather than dRA/dt*cos(dec), and return status distinguishes dubious from unacceptable dates. SOFA Time Scale Tools distinguishes UTC and UT1 and requires caller-supplied UT1-UTC for matching UTC; release 19 is dated 2023-10-11.
claims.scope: SOFA Astrometry Tools C cookbook revision 1.13 and Time Scale C cookbook revision 1.63 dated 2023-05-31, used with SOFA release 19; input availability and accuracy remain caller responsibilities.

source_refs.locator: Sections 1.1-1.2 and detailed iauAtco13 listing, printed pages 55-57 (PDF viewer pages 58-60)
Sections 3.5 and 4.3.1; iauDtf2d/iauUtcut1 guidance, PDF pages 12-24 and 63
Issue 2023-10-11 release date and unified nineteenth-release statement

object_craft.structure: Blender authors a unit-radius horizon dome, north/east cardinal frame, ground mask and observatory silhouette in a documented local ENU display frame; glTF exports only these static named nodes.
object_craft.material: Stars use size plus label/shape, not brightness alone; horizon and below-horizon states differ geometrically.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js retains the catalog/input ledger, invokes the pinned SOFA binding outside glTF, converts returned azimuth/zenith-distance radians into ENU directions, rebuilds stable-ID link buffers, marks below-horizon state and resets inputs exactly.

physical_contract.scope: Reference-frame transformation and catalog playback; no orbital or stellar physics.
